content.title: Residents Demand Halts for Long-Distance Trains at Melmaruvathur
content.caption: Residents in several villages around Melmaruvathur, a spiritual and commercial hub, demand stops for long-distance trains, including Vande Bharat and Amrit Bharat, at the Melmaruvathur Railway Station.

slides.heading: Residents Demand Halts for Long-Distance Trains at Melmaruvathur
slides.text: Residents in several villages around Melmaruvathur, a spiritual and commercial hub, demand stops for long-distance trains, including Vande Bharat and Amrit Bharat, at the Melmaruvathur Railway Station.

slides.heading: Resident Petitions
slides.text: The residents of several villages around Melmaruvathur, including Seyyur, Sithamur, Lathur, and Maduranthakam, have petitioned the Southern Railway to add stoppages for mail and express trains at the Melmaruvathur Railway Station.

slides.heading: Resident Demands
slides.text: Residents in several villages around Melmaruvathur, including Seyyur, Sithamur, Lathur, and Maduranthakam, have demanded stops for long-distance trains, including Vande Bharat and Amrit Bharat, at the Melmaruvathur Railway Station.
